owner.title: Hi — I'm Jill.
owner.p1: I have been welcoming families to Old Orchard Beach for more than a decade. Multiple units in nearby buildings means we are ready to host anyone from couples, to big families, and to reunions up to 16. All nearby and only a 5-minute walk from 7 miles of open sandy beaches.
owner.p2: When you message me, you're talking to me. I usually reply within the hour, and I'm the one handing you the keypad code on arrival. No app middleman, no support ticket queue.
owner.p3: If something's not right during your stay, I want to hear about it — and I want to fix it.
